audit.why: Level chart (phases[].side) and content win[] already agree on every row and match the packet's levelChart exactly (Skill/Skill/Maokai/Maokai/Maokai/Skill/Skill). No chart edit needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Maokai's W and R as things to track but gives no actual cooldown numbers (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Twisted Advance (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s and Nature's Grasp (R) is 130/110/90s per the kit; stating the real numbers lets the reader count down the engage window instead of just being told to 'count it'.
audit.corrected: Twisted Advance (W) is 14s at rank 1, falling to 10s at rank 5 — count it before you step up. Your own Magical Journey (E) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. Nature's Grasp (R) is 130/110/90s and opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Maokai's Twisted Advance (W) is untargetable mid-dash, which isn't stated anywhere on the page — dosFull[0].d only says to count the cooldown, not that spending a combo into the dash itself whiffs.
audit.why: Twisted Advance's kit flag is untargetable: 'dodges timed burst and executes'. Bard's stun/engage combo thrown at the dash animation is wasted; the punish window is after the root lands or the dash whiffs.
audit.corrected: Point-and-click root, but he's untargetable mid-dash — don't burn your combo into the dash itself, wait for the root to land or whiff, then punish. Commit on his cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. It writes your spacing rules. - E Magical Journey is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Twisted Advance (W) is 14s at rank 1, falling to 10s at rank 5 — count it before you step up. Your own Magical Journey (E) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. Nature's Grasp (R) is 130/110/90s and opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.after: Point-and-click root, but he's untargetable mid-dash — don't burn your combo into the dash itself, wait for the root to land or whiff, then punish. Commit on his cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Nature's Grasp stops time on everyone it catches — cast it when his duo is fully committed past the wave, not as a reflex answer to their engage.

edits.before: The R stases EVERYTHING — allies, towers, and your own carry's ult; aim it like a verdict.
edits.after: Open-field Q telegraphs and wastes a stun that wins the engage war — save Bramble Smash for terrain-adjacent chains, not chip damage.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Tempered Fate stops your own team too — a reflex R off your carry's burst removes their damage from the fight for its duration.
